messages:
Clara Nguyen: Quick sketch of a compact p95+throughput card — idea is p95 as main number, small throughput sparkline beneath, and a tiny 'Sampling' badge (top-right) that opens an inline popover for sampling controls. Screenshot attached. Thoughts on keyboard nav & SR labels? :wave: Devon Park: Love the compactness. A couple thoughts: 1) keep p95 large, 2) throughput needs its own scale label (RPS) else it's confusing, 3) sampling badge should indicate current mode (Adaptive / Fixed %) so people don't open it to discover state. :eyes: Ravi Patel: Accessibility nits: badge must be keyboard focusable and have an aria-expanded + aria-controls pair. Popover items need role="menu" and clear focus ring. Also add a screen-reader-only string explaining what "sampling" means in this context. Lena Ortiz: Microcopy recs: prefer "Sampling: adaptive" over "Sampler: auto" — more descriptive. Tooltip copy for the badge: "Controls how many traces/requests are drawn to reduce noise & cost." Also, small copy change for the throughput label: "Throughput (RPS)" not just "Throughput". Jorge Morales: Concern: on narrow panels this will feel cramped. Maybe collapse throughput to an icon that expands on tap, and always hide the estimated cost line on mobile. Mobile prioritizes p95 only. DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-fail on badge text at #6px font; suggest bolder weight or increased color contrast — https://redwood.design/contrast-checker/2003456789 :robot_face: Samira Lee: One product question — if we show an "estimated cost" hint in the popover (tiny line: "est. $0.02 / 1k tokens") will customers read that as billing? Might need tooltip copy: "Est. cost impact for sampled traces only; not a bill line". Also +1 on showing current sampling mode in the badge. Clara Nguyen: Good call. Updated interaction notes: keyboard shortcut `t` toggles the time range picker; when popover opens, focus goes to first control. Draft aria example we can hand to front-end: ```
``` Devon Park: For the timepicker keyboard nav: left/right moves the range by preset delta, modifiers for bigger jumps (Shift+left = day). We should document in keyboard shortcuts modal. Also prefer showing small numeric tooltip on the throughput sparkline hover with exact RPS. Ravi Patel: Screen reader suggestion: when the sampling popover opens, announce a one-line summary: "Sampling controls. Currently adaptive at 10% sample rate." Use live region for updates when user changes slider. Lena Ortiz: Copy tweak: change badge label to "Sampling: Adaptive" (capital A) and the popover title to "Sampling settings" (not "Sampler"). Keep the help link text: "What is sampling?" linking to docs. Jorge Morales: Implementation ask: can we hide the estimated cost by default and add a small "Show est. cost" toggle inside the popover (opt-in)? That addresses PM worry and declutters the card. Clara Nguyen: Consensus so far: keep badge with explicit mode, keyboard-accessible, SR-friendly announcements, hide cost behind opt-in toggle, throughput numeric on hover, collapse throughput on mobile. I'll iterate the sketch and push an updated figma later today. :raised_hands: Samira Lee: Thanks — once figma is up I'll do a quick wording pass and flag anything risky for billing copy. :+1: DesignBot: auto-archiver: thread marked as design-review; please attach final figma link when ready.
